title: DuwatBench: Bridging Language and Visual Heritage through an Arabic Calligraphy Benchmark for Multimodal Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative evaluation using metrics like Character Error Rate (CER), Word Error Rate (WER), and ExactMatch across diverse, stylized Arabic calligraphic scripts to reveal pretraining biases that favor standard, linear text (often Latin-centric) over visually complex and culturally grounded writing systems.

Qualitative error analysis of model outputs to detect the hallucination or overprediction of culturally and religiously loaded terms (e.g., expanding 'Bismillah' to the full Basmala or overpredicting the word 'Allah'), demonstrating reliance on cultural priors rather than actual visual evidence.
